caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
raw_response:
The figure consists of two vertically stacked line plots illustrating training rewards over a series of steps for different training sets. Both plots share an x-axis labeled "Steps" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, featuring tick marks at intervals of 100.

The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," has a y-axis labeled "Training Rewards" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.45, with tick marks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4. It displays two solid lines with shaded confidence intervals. The teal line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," begins near 0.02 at step 0, rises to approximately 0.35 by step 200, fluctuates between 0.3 and 0.38, and ends near 0.35 at step 500. The red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," starts near 0.01 at step 0, increases steadily to approximately 0.3 by step 200, surpasses the teal line around step 320, and continues to rise with minor fluctuations, ending near 0.4 at step 500.

The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," has a y-axis labeled "Training Rewards" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.22, with tick marks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. It displays two solid lines with shaded confidence intervals. The teal line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," starts near 0.02 at step 0, slightly rises to about 0.03 around step 20, then declines to 0.0 by step 100, remaining flat at 0.0 until the line terminates near step 180. The red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," begins near 0.01 at step 0, exhibits a steady upward trend with fluctuations, reaches approximately 0.1 by step 100, and ends near 0.2 at step 500.
